info.title: Catat Uang API
info.description: Authenticated transaction and bill API with transaction synchronization protocol. Flutter provides opt-in manual transaction synchronization. All known paths reject unsupported methods with JSON 405 and Allow. Unknown paths return JSON 404. HEAD responses have no body. Use HTTPS outside local development.

SyncMutation.description: Stable operation ID for retries. Create: base_version 0 and payload required. Replace/restore: current base_version and payload required. Delete: positive base_version, deleted true, payload null or omitted. Reusing an operation ID with different content returns 409. No If-Match header is used.
